title: MaleTheme Solo #010 · 남 피트니스 모델·에메랄드 라인·카우보이 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in golden sand dunes under a clear sky with a smooth flat sand foreground and a standard-height wooden gate frame standing at his side, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Turkish man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty-boy idol face with flawless smooth skin, large clear eyes, a slim jaw and soft full lips, clean-shaven, bold emerald-green eyeliner with a sheer burgundy-stained lip, fair olive skin with a warm undertone, a calm gentle gaze, soft rose-gold hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold round bell, an iron barrel-shaped weight, a tin ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large copper hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a bronze teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three platinum bracelets. Extremely long oval nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a brown leather cowboy hat, a red bandana knotted at his neck, a silver sheriff star pinned on a thin leather chest strap, and a minimal brown leather with silver studs T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his stomach bare.
SUBJECT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue platform stiletto studded boots, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
